name: discovery_comparison
title: Discovery across repetitions
description: Current and cumulative judge-scored discovery, with a fixed set of holes.

name: stages_current
title: Attempted → executed → successful; discovery alongside · final repetition only
description: All bars use the same hole denominator. Discovery is a separate judge label. Success is positive predefined local benefit, not probability of winning.

name: stages_cumulative
title: Attempted → executed → successful; discovery alongside · ever by final repetition
description: All bars use the same hole denominator. Discovery is a separate judge label. Success is positive predefined local benefit, not probability of winning.

name: radar_current
title: Discovery and exploit rates by your four groups · final repetition
description: Each axis is the share of game-specific holes in that group. A/B/C/D denominators are shown; categories with more game instances receive more weight. Exploit rate is unconditional engine execution, not execution conditional on discovery.

name: radar_cumulative
title: Discovery and exploit rates by your four groups · cumulative
description: Each axis is the share of game-specific holes in that group. A/B/C/D denominators are shown; categories with more game instances receive more weight. Exploit rate is unconditional engine execution, not execution conditional on discovery.

name: groups_discovered
title: Cumulative discovery by group
description: Group learning curves; equal weight per game-specific hole within each group.

name: groups_executed
title: Cumulative exploit execution by group
description: Group learning curves; equal weight per game-specific hole within each group.
